Makes the listener a ball instead of a point, so that a sound that passes close by moves from one speaker to the other and changes its pitch over a moment instead of all at once. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; The player is a ship of about 4 units across.
ListenerRadius 2
```
@param value  The radius in units of the world. `0` (the default) is a point, as in the original. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap The radius is added to the one of the sound ([ChannelRadius](ChannelRadius)). The panning and the doppler speeds then use the direction divided by the square root of distance² + radius² instead of the distance, so they are weaker close by and the same as before far away. The volume does not change with the radius. [GetListenerRadius](GetListenerRadius) tells the value.
